name: John Daly - Fairway Runtz | 1.2 G Handcraft
description:
Fairway Runtz (John Daly) | 1.2G Handcraft | HYMAN | REC 
The HYMAN 1.2G Handcraft is a next-level pre-roll designed for those who appreciate true flower integrity. Rolled exclusively with a single, intact nug of premium HYMAN flower, each Handcraft maintains maximum flavor and potency. Finished with a glass tip and H2O brushed for a smooth, even burn, this is a thoughtfully engineered smoke from start to finish. 
One nug. One roll. 
Crafted to stand apart. 
Strain Type: Indica 
Mood: Peaceful & Relaxed 
Flavor & Aroma: Candy, Melon
